description: TrustyMUSE Harness V1.6. Local only, multi-tenant. TrustyMUSE is the controller, other models are workers. Subscription mode is on by default, API mode is off by default and blocked when the monthly budget cap is 0. Nine subscription chat models connect with a Connect button: chatgpt, claude, gemini, grok, deepseek, perplexity, meta-ai, copilot, mistral. Packet mode works for every connected model; the browser driver is wired only for chatgpt and claude. Browser sessions connect and disconnect per account with a verified login check: browser-connect, browser-disconnect, browser-status. Any running or new project can connect and scope jobs to it. One install serves many Muse accounts, each tenant fully isolated.
name: trustymuse-harness
